response.rationale: Both forms denote a celebration for an engagement. Indonesian commonly uses “pesta pertunangan,” while Malaysian Malay commonly uses “majlis pertunangan,” making this a useful everyday preference contrast.
response.risk_rationale: Borrowed or regional alternatives may occur, but they do not materially undermine the contrast.
response.shared_synonym_rationale: “Pesta pertunangan” can be understood in Malaysia, but “majlis pertunangan” is the ordinary Malaysian preference; the proposed Indonesian form remains natural in Indonesian.
